_comment: Curated fixes for ΔΑΣΕ contracts whose registry stated values are keying errors. Keyed by contract ΑΔΑΜ. Fields: total_cost_with_vat / total_cost_without_vat override the registry amounts when the signed PDF documents a different figure (cite the source in 'reason'); optional 'objects' maps contract_objects seq → corrected cost_without_vat where the child row repeats the error. Applied by khmdhs.contract_corrections — standalone CLI and at the end of every harvest_dase.py load (its INSERT OR REPLACE restores registry values). Candidates come from scripts/validate_contract_values.py; corrections land only after human PDF review (DATA_DECISIONS 2026-08-14). exclude:true + duplicate_of:<kept ΑΔΑΜ> marks a registry double-posting: the applier sets cancelled=1, correction_note and contracts.duplicate_of; the page stays reachable and cross-linked (DATA_DECISIONS 2026-08-14, double-postings entry).

21SYMV009374147.reason: KHMDHS records net €2,537,393.13 / gross €3,146,367.48 — a ×10-scale digit-glitch keying error. The signed contract PDF (contract/attachment/21SYMV009374147) states «253.739,13» net + ΦΠΑ = «314.636,52»; all 7 sibling lots of the same Δασαρχείο Λίμνης πρόσκληση (21PROC009329287) carry exactly €253,739.13 net, and its own payment orders total €313,316.42 gross (€252,674.53 net) ≈ full settlement.

Normalized texts 98% identical — only the in-document ΑΦΜ, one date and one protocol number differ; same parties, same €13,395.00. The full-settlement payment 24PAY015905505 sits on the kept re-issue (DATA_DECISIONS 2026-08-15).

24SYMV015692415.reason: Registry keying error: the contract row repeats the GROSS figure in the net field (totalCostWithoutVAT = totalCostWithVAT = 490.000,00, vat_percent '0'), so every net-basis aggregate counted a VAT-inclusive amount. Its own payment order 25PAY016222564 (ΑΔΑ 9ΦΞΖ4653Π8-ΘΩΩ) splits that same gross at 24% and states the net: 395.161,29. True net = 490.000,00 / 1,24 = 395.161,29. The signed PDF mentions ΦΠΑ once, citing the exemption procedure (ΥΑ Α.1021/07-02-2022, Β΄550) in recital 14, and άρθρο 5 states the price «συμπεριλαμβανομένων και όλων των νόμιμων φορολογικών επιβαρύνσεων» without naming a rate — the payment order is the deciding document (DATA_DECISIONS 2026-08-17).
